title: Initialize BIT Array
description: Create an array tree[1..n] initialized to 0. Each index i will store the sum of elements in range [i - LSB(i) + 1, i]. Build the tree by processing each element: for index i, add arr[i] to tree[i] and propagate to all responsible ancestors using i += LSB(i).

title: Compute LSB (Least Significant Bit)
description: The key operation: LSB(i) = i & (-i). This isolates the lowest set bit of i. In two's complement: -i = ~i + 1. LSB(6) = 2 (binary 110 → 010), LSB(8) = 8 (1000).

title: Point Update Operation
description: To add delta to arr[i], start at index i. Add delta to tree[i], then move to i + LSB(i). Repeat until i exceeds n. This updates all intervals that include position i.

title: Prefix Sum Query
description: To compute sum of arr[1..i], start with sum = 0 at index i. Add tree[i] to sum, then move to i - LSB(i). Repeat until i becomes 0. Each step covers a range ending at current i.

title: Range Sum Query
description: To compute sum in range [l, r], use: range_sum(l, r) = prefix_sum(r) - prefix_sum(l-1). This is the standard prefix-suffix difference technique.
